draft.title: Changing biomes to grow more
card: Irrigation
Irrigation brings water to crops from rivers, dams or bores. It lets farmers grow crops where rain alone is too low.
Fertilisers
Fertilisers add nutrients to the soil so crops grow bigger. Pesticides kill insects, weeds or fungi that damage crops.
Seeds
New seed varieties are bred to give more food, or to cope with dry weather or disease.
Terracing
Terracing cuts flat steps into a steep hillside. It slows running water, so crops can grow on slopes without soil washing away.
draft.remember: These methods help people grow more food than the natural biome could.

a.q: What is the main purpose of terracing?
opts: To grow crops on steep slopes
To bring water from a river
To add nutrients to the soil
a.why: Terraces turn a steep hillside into flat steps that hold soil and water. Irrigation brings water, fertilisers add nutrients, and pesticides kill pests.
a.clue: Think of steps cut into a hillside.

b.q: A farm in a dry part of South Australia has poor soil and little rain. Which change would best help it grow more wheat?
opts: Leaving the crop to grow naturally
b.why: The problems are low rain and poor soil, so water and added nutrients fix them. Terracing suits steep hills, and the land is not described as steep. Pesticides only fight pests.
b.clue: Match each method to the problem it solves.

a.best: To grow crops on steep slopes

problems.detail: The 'Fertilisers' bullet also defines pesticides, so a student may read pesticides as a kind of fertiliser. Pesticides need their own heading.
The distractor 'Terracing and pesticide only' is the only option with 'only'. This flags it as wrong without the student needing to know the idea. Remove 'only'.

proposal.title: Changing biomes to grow more
card: Water
Irrigation brings water to crops from rivers, dams or bores. It lets farmers grow crops where rain alone is too low.
Soil
Fertilisers add nutrients to poor soil so crops grow bigger. Terracing cuts flat steps into steep hills, so crops can grow on slopes without soil washing away.
Pests
Pesticides are chemicals that kill insects, weeds or fungi that damage crops. They protect the crop but do not feed it.
Seeds
New seed varieties are bred to give more food, or to cope with dry weather or disease.
proposal.remember: These methods help people grow more food than the natural biome could.

a.q: What is the main purpose of terracing?
opts: To grow crops on steep slopes
To bring water from a river
To add nutrients to the soil
a.why: Terraces turn a steep hillside into flat steps that hold the soil in place. Bringing water is irrigation, adding nutrients is fertiliser, and killing insects is a pesticide's job.
a.clue: Think of steps cut into a hillside.

b.q: A farm in a dry part of South Australia has poor soil and little rain. Which change would best help it grow more wheat?
b.why: The problems are low rain and poor soil, so the farm needs both water and added nutrients. Terracing and irrigation fixes the water but not the soil, and terracing suits steep hills, which this farm is not described as having. Pesticides fight pests, not poor soil or dry weather.
b.clue: The farm has two problems. Pick the pair that fixes both.
